[EN] Hadrah was the best wife a man could ask for. Fearless, beautiful, perfect right hook...

I do not plan on remarrying. Ever. Hadrah will always be my wife.
[ES] Hadrah era la mejor esposa que un hombre could pedir. Valiente, hermosa, un gancho derecho perfecto...

No planeo volver a casarme. Nunca. Hadrah siempre será mi esposa.
